I wrote `component.html` in this folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and uses only the light-theme values from `tokens.css`, copied inline so the file is self-contained. The three sections are separate cards on a white page. "Save Changes" is the one primary (ink) button, and "Delete Workspace" is the outlined secondary style, with no red. The switches are real checkboxes with `role="switch"` and no JavaScript.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they fall back to system fonts. The sizes and spacing still come from the tokens.
- **Switch defaults:** I set the first two switches on and "Product updates" off, so both states show. You didn't specify defaults, so change them if you want something else.
- **Save Changes placement:** The spec puts the primary action in the top row, but your content puts "Save Changes" in the General section. I kept it in General, so the top row is just the heading.
